name: Shouten! Mononoke Mura!!
source:
Yagyuu Amami (pseudonym) is a rounin who makes a living by doing phony monster-exorcisms. Wearing priest’s robes stolen from a temple and a sword at his waist,
he travels from village to village tricking country folk and squeezing out enough coins to get by.

One day in a post town, broke and out of options, Amami takes on an exorcism request but what he found there… were actual youkai.
translation:
柳生天海（化名）是一名以虚假驱魔为生的流氓。穿着从寺庙偷来的祭司长袍，腰间佩剑，
他从一个村庄到另一个村庄，欺骗乡下人，并挤出足够的硬币来度日。

有一天，在一个驿站小镇，天海陷入了困境，别无选择，他接受了驱魔请求，但他在那里发现的……是真正的妖怪。
